query: Moss Inference credits exhausted error status code

text: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests, with error type "usage_limit" and error code "usage_limit_exceeded". It means your credits ran out and usage is paused; add credits (see Pricing > Credits). This is distinct from the per-minute 429 with code "rate_limit_exceeded" (type "requests" or "tokens"), which you retry after Retry-After. The error body has OpenAI shape: {"error": {"message", "type", "code"}}.
